usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-wide, font-semibold (600). Use for widget titles and section headers.
usage_rules.body: Clean, legible. Use for descriptions and logs.
usage_rules.mono: MANDATORY for all financial data, prices, PnL, and timestamps. Tabular nums.

containers.widget: bg-card border border-border rounded-sm overflow-hidden relative
containers.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)]

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-none uppercase tracking-wider font-rajdhani font-semibold h-10 px-6
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 rounded-none uppercase tracking-wider font-rajdhani font-semibold h-10 px-6
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-none uppercase tracking-wider font-rajdhani h-10 px-6
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-none font-rajdhani h-10 px-4

inputs.style: bg-background border-input rounded-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary font-mono text-sm h-10

badges.style: rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wide border border-transparent

visual_enhancers.shadows: none (flat design preferred for terminal look)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border border-white/10 (Use for overlays/modals only)

theme.tooltip: bg-background border border-border rounded-none shadow-xl text-xs font-mono

universal_rules: Use 'Rajdhani' for all UI labels, headers, and buttons.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL numbers, prices, hashes, and timestamps.
Do not use rounded corners > 4px. Prefer 0px or 2px.
Always show a 'Status' indicator (green dot) for active agents.
PnL values must always be colored (Green for +, Red for -).
Use 'Skeleton' loaders for data fetching states.
Dark mode is the ONLY mode. Do not implement light mode toggle.
Use 'sonner' for notifications (Trade executed, Error, etc.).
implementation_guide.instructions_to_main_agent:
You are building a professional crypto trading terminal. The aesthetic is 'Cyber-Swiss' - precise, dark, and high-contrast. 

1. **Layout**: Use the 'Control Room' grid. The dashboard should feel like a cockpit. No wasted whitespace. 
2. **Data**: Real-time updates are key. Use the 'pulse-green' animation on price changes. 
3. **Risk**: The 'Kill Switch' must be prominent and dangerous-looking (Red gradient). 
4. **Agents**: Each agent (DCA, Grid, Trend) gets a card. Show their status (Running/Stopped) clearly. 
5. **Charts**: Use Recharts. Remove all grid lines except minimal horizontal guides. Custom tooltips are mandatory.
